id: # Store items. kind: story_points / skill_points / levels / credits / commodity / special_item / perk (target = a skill id) / peerless_point. stock -1 = no limit per game. requiresMod: a mod id or empty; a|b = either. Every colony item is added to Rare in code. Descriptions say plainly what the item does.

name: Peerless point
description: Adds 1 Peerless skill point.

name: Arc Sustainer
description: Colony item.

name: S-mod slot (+1)
description: Adds 1 S-mod slot to one ship.

name: D-mod removal
description: Removes every D-mod from one ship.

name: Stat tuning
description: Improves one stat of one ship.

name: Extra ordnance points (2 / 6 / 15 / 40)
description: Adds ordnance points to one ship by hull size.

name: Deep Holds
description: +10% cargo, fuel and crew capacity on every ship.

name: Time Flow
description: +1% time flow on every ship in combat.

name: Extra Armor
description: +50 / 100 / 200 / 300 armor on frigates, destroyers, cruisers and capital ships.

name: Last Stand
description: Once per battle each ship repairs 10% of its hull instead of being destroyed.

name: Slow Moving
description: +1 to the highest burn level that counts as moving slowly.

name: Max Burn
description: +1 maximum burn level for the fleet.

name: Lean Maintenance
description: -10% supplies per month on every ship.

name: Combat Readiness
description: +5% maximum combat readiness on every ship.

name: Sensor Range
description: +10% sensor range for the fleet.

name: Fast Refit
description: Fighters are replaced 25% faster.

name: Fighter Speed
description: +15% fighter top speed and acceleration.

name: Fighter Armor
description: +50% fighter armor.

name: Fighter Hull
description: +25% fighter hull.

name: Fighter Damage
description: +10% fighter weapon damage.

name: Fighter Range
description: +20% fighter engagement range.
